literal_meaning: পথ দান করা (way or path to give)
figurative_meaning_en: to provide the opportunity to go or pass
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় বক্তার জন্য পথ দিয়ে উঠুন।
example_sentences_in_english: Make way for the car on the road.
Step aside to let the speaker pass in the meeting.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural norms of politeness and yielding space.
